mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declined for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by > 2% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% for 3 consecutive months) signals a stable economic backdrop, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors favor equities over fixed income.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL was below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in the last month signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increased by > 10% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) within the last month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in the last two months signals a strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised upwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increased by > 5% in the last two months.
